body.summary: Added the team commands: src/cli/services/team.ts (teamInit and teamRefresh return one result line and throw a plain Error on failure), the team entry in the Services interface and makeServices, two help lines, and the team dispatch case with runTeam in src/cli/command.ts (sub words init and refresh, optional path defaulting to the selected repo, --branch name flag with usage errors for a missing name, a stray argument or --branch on init). Both test facades gained the team entry; command.test.ts covers dispatch, help, --branch pass-through, the rendered refusal asking for it and cross-prefixed errors. An extra end-to-end file (team-service.test.ts, HOME pointed at a scratch dir so the real ~/.insrc is untouched) runs the real commands against real git: team refresh --branch fixes a dangling remote HEAD and the reader then returns the policy; team init writes a starter the reader accepts once on the default branch. Left out: nothing beyond the plan; gates.ts is untouched.
